categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and adds unit test cases to src/test/data/script_tests.json and src/test/script_tests.cpp to cover interpreter code paths.
categories.rationale: Adds test cases to script_tests.json covering consensus interpreter edge cases identified via mutation testing. The test infrastructure category prioritizes coverage of high-risk code paths that other tests do not reach—especially consensus—and tests that catch realistic regressions. Mutation testing and reviewer verification confirmed that logic alterations in interpreter.cpp previously passed undetected and are now caught.
